name: opencode-switchman
description: OpenCode orchestration plugin: six-lane shell matrix dispatch (hard ROUTE_META validation / breaker self-healing / probes / three-pool quota awareness / cost-aware tiebreaker)

scripts.build: bun run gen:shells && bun scripts/gen-version.ts && bun build src/index.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/opencode-switchman.js && bun build src/doctor-cli.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/switchman-doctor.js && bun build src/config-cli.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/switchman-config.js && bun scripts/build-tui.ts && cp scripts/update-cli.mjs dist/update-cli.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run build && bun test
scripts.mode:local: bun run build && bun scripts/plugin-mode.ts local
